# Pawsport Concierge

> Private pet travel concierge based in Miami, Florida, operating worldwide. We manage the entire journey between home and boarding for pets flying with their owners: veterinary appointments, government paperwork, airline approval in writing, departure-day support. A named concierge replies within 15 minutes, 8am-10pm ET, every day. We also run an everyday pet concierge desk in Miami: grooming, dog walking, vet visits, pet hotel and day care.

Key facts:
- Based in Miami, FL; routes worldwide — any country, any airline, both directions
- Cabin-first policy: pets travel in cabin whenever the airline allows it; cargo hold only as a last resort agreed with the owner
- Fixed written quote before any payment; third-party fees itemized separately
- Contact: hello@pawsportconcierge.com, +1 (305) 954-0956, WhatsApp available
- Website: https://www.pawsportconcierge.com
